referenceScenario.description: US lottery lump-sum prize equivalent to roughly 1,500 억원 (~$100M USD at ~1,490 KRW/USD), taxed as a non-resident alien under IRS withholding, then taxed again (or credited) under the resident's home-country rules.
referenceScenario.note: Percentages are ratios and are not sensitive to the exact reference amount, except where a country's tax is bracketed/progressive.

methodology: US federal nonresident alien withholding is a flat 30% under IRC §871(a) unless reduced by an income tax treaty. Each country's 'additional tax' reflects that country's own tax treatment of foreign lottery/incidental income, after applying a Foreign Tax Credit (FTC) for US tax already withheld where the country's treaty and domestic law allow it. See each country's chamtax.com detail page for citations.

confidenceLevels.verified: Rate is based on an identifiable statute, treaty article, or official tax authority guidance.
confidenceLevels.verified_treaty_suspended: Rate is based on treaty/statute, but the underlying tax treaty is currently suspended (e.g. Russia) — treat with extra caution.
confidenceLevels.approximate: Rate is a reasonable approximation from available secondary sources, not a primary legal citation.
confidenceLevels.unverified_estimate: No authoritative source was found; this is a best-effort estimate and should not be relied on for filing.
